name: My Zypps Cryo Half Ounce - Apple Gelato
description:
Infused and ready to roll. The My Zypps Apple Gelato half ounce delivers 14 grams of pre-ground flower, cryo-infused for extra potency and full flavor — no grinder needed, just scoop and go.

Apple Gelato brings a sweet, dessert-forward profile: crisp green apple up front with creamy gelato sweetness and a smooth, earthy finish.

14G pre-ground cryo-infused flower — half ounce, ready to roll straight from the bag
Cryo-infused — extra potency with a smooth, even burn
Signature Apple Gelato flavor — crisp apple with creamy gelato sweetness

My Zypps Apple Gelato is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
